invariants: Read-only: no method on this trait may mutate state or append an event.
Every call is owner- and project-scoped by the implementation; the trait surface carries project_alias on every method so scoping is never ambient.
Pagination is cursor-based everywhere: list by cursor_task_id, events by after_sequence, result by an opaque chunk cursor with a byte bound.
responsibilities: WorkReadPort: the read side of the Python WorkStore - get, list_tasks, events, result, cicd_stage_log - as one synchronous trait in pure domain types.
summary: The read port: bounded projections and cursor-paginated reads over admitted work.
